[{"word":"bound","pronun":"[baʊnd]","translation":"n. 范围；跳跃
adj. 有义务的；必定的；受约束的；装有封面的
vt. 束缚；使跳跃
vi. 限制；弹起","audio":"bound.mp3"},{"word":"bowel","pronun":"[ˈbaʊəl]","translation":"n. 肠；内部；同情
vt. 将……的肚肠取出","audio":"bowel.mp3"},{"word":"boycott","pronun":"[ˈbɔɪkɑːt]","translation":"n. 联合抵制
vt. 联合抵制；拒绝参加","audio":"boycott.mp3"},{"word":"brace","pronun":"[breɪs]","translation":"n. 支柱；[语] 大括号；曲柄
vt. 支撑；振作起来；激励；撑牢
adj. 曲柄的
vi. 支持；打起精神","audio":"brace.mp3"},{"word":"bracket","pronun":"[ˈbrækɪt]","translation":"n. 支架；括号；墙上凸出的托架
vt. 括在一起；把…归入同一类；排除","audio":"bracket.mp3"},{"word":"brand","pronun":"[brænd]","translation":"n. 商标，牌子；烙印
vt. 铭刻于，铭记；打烙印于；印…商标于","audio":"brand.mp3"},{"word":"breach","pronun":"[briːtʃ]","translation":"n. 违背，违反；缺口
vt. 违反，破坏；打破","audio":"breach.mp3"},{"word":"breakdown","pronun":"[ˈbreɪkdaʊn]","translation":"n. 故障；崩溃；分解；分类；衰弱；跺脚曳步舞","audio":"breakdown.mp3"},{"word":"breakthrough","pronun":"[ˈbreɪkθruː]","translation":"n. 突破；突破性进展","audio":"breakthrough.mp3"},{"word":"breed","pronun":"[briːd]","translation":"n. [生物] 品种；种类，类型
vt. 繁殖；饲养；养育，教育；引起
vi. 繁殖；饲养；产生","audio":"breed.mp3"},{"word":"brew","pronun":"[bruː]","translation":"n. 啤酒；质地
vi. 酿酒；被冲泡；即将发生
vt. 酿造；酝酿","audio":"brew.mp3"},{"word":"bribe","pronun":"[braɪb]","translation":"n. 贿赂
vt. 贿赂，收买
vi. 行贿","audio":"bribe.mp3"},{"word":"brief","pronun":"[briːf]","translation":"n. 摘要，简报；概要，诉书
adj. 简短的，简洁的；短暂的，草率的
vt. 简报，摘要；作…的提要","audio":"brief.mp3"},{"word":"briefcase","pronun":"[ˈbriːfkeɪs]","translation":"n. 公文包","audio":"briefcase.mp3"},{"word":"brilliant","pronun":"[ˈbrɪliənt]","translation":"adj. 灿烂的，闪耀的；杰出的；有才气的；精彩的，绝妙的","audio":"brilliant.mp3"},{"word":"brink","pronun":"[brɪŋk]","translation":"n. （峭壁的）边缘","audio":"brink.mp3"},{"word":"brisk","pronun":"[brɪsk]","translation":"adj. 敏锐的，活泼的，轻快的；凛冽的
vt. 使……活泼；使……轻快；使……兴旺
vi. 活跃起来；变得轻快","audio":"brisk.mp3"},{"word":"brochure","pronun":"[broʊˈʃʊr]","translation":"n. 手册，小册子","audio":"brochure.mp3"},{"word":"bronze","pronun":"[brɑːnz]","translation":"n. 青铜；古铜色；青铜制品

vt. 镀青铜于
vi. 变成青铜色，被晒黑","audio":"bronze.mp3"},{"word":"brood","pronun":"[bruːd]","translation":"n. 一窝；一伙
vt. 孵；沉思","audio":"brood.mp3"}]
